scope: Local runtime implementation and regression proof for per-device visibility through the Editor Inspector, Layers panel, Canvas, draft Save, and explicit Publish.

implementation.behavior: Each non-root layer has a keyboard-accessible visibility button that shows its pressed state and targets the Canvas active device (desktop/tablet/mobile). It invokes the existing element.visibility.set command and Page Model property; Inspector and Layers do not maintain duplicate state. Locked nodes disable the control. Save remains draft-only and Publish is explicit.

Layer visibility control follows mobile Canvas device state, updates Canvas, remains draft-only after Save, and reaches the published Page Model only after explicit Publish.
